description: Prebuilt law library for Canon: the Internal Revenue Code (26 U.S.C., through Public Law 119-73) and the Treasury regulations (26 CFR Parts 1 and 301, eCFR as of 2025-12-31). 6,877 section rows, 129,054 passages, FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, and each document's source files.
_notes: GitHub Release asset (law-v1 tag). Optional: nothing needs law.db until an agent or a person asks for the law. Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta).
